detail.longDescription: None of the 179 Agent Skills OX Security flagged ran code at install. 44% told the agent to send data out. A scanner hunting for install hooks sees nothing: the payload is prose the agent acts on mid-run. https://www. ox.security/blog/plug-and-pray -your-ai-agents-are-taking-orders-from-strangers/ So the run is where it shows. If you want a second reviewer watching an agent's terminal live, that's what we built https:// shell.online # AIAgents # Cybersecurity # OpenSource
